hero.badge: Engineering Operations · Resource Planning · Delivery Visibility
hero.title: Engineering Operation Board
hero.subtitle: An engineering operations platform that connects worklogs, resource planning, project visibility, and execution reporting into one operating layer.
hero.author: Gerald Park

why.title: Why We Built This
why.subtitle: Daily inputs, monthly planning, project progress, and cost classification lived in different tools, which made operational judgment slow and heavy.

scattered.title: Scattered Data
scattered.description: Worklogs lived in Excel, planning lived in SharePoint, and project context lived in mail threads and meeting notes. There was no single source of truth for engineering operations.

manual.title: Manual Tracking
manual.description: Plan-versus-actual reporting required rebuilding the same view from multiple files every month. The real cost was not just calculation, but repeated reassembly of context.

visibility.title: Limited Visibility
visibility.description: Team capacity, project allocation, and resource conflicts could not be seen in one place. Decisions depended on stale snapshots and tribal memory.

what.title: What Operating Stack It Uses
what.subtitle: Instead of solving input, planning, reporting, and governance separately, this full-stack system connects them into one operational flow.

portal.title: Unified Portal
portal.desc: A home base that connects multiple operational tools and workflows through one entry point.

dashboard.title: Operations Dashboard
dashboard.desc: Real-time charts, heatmaps, and weekly summaries that let teams read execution context quickly.

resourceMatrix.title: Resource Matrix
resourceMatrix.desc: A single workspace for monthly FTE allocation and scenario-based capacity planning.

api.title: Operations API
api.desc: A layered API server that ties together SSO, permissions, and the project-resource-reporting flow.

classification.title: Work & Cost Classification Engine
classification.desc: Context and priority rules automatically organize inputs into the operational classification model.

schema.title: Organization & Project Hierarchy
schema.desc: Operational modeling of organization and project structures for reporting and delivery visibility.

dimensions.title: Financial Dimensions
dimensions.desc: IO, activity codes, and cost buckets tied together so recharge and cost ownership stay consistent.

sync.title: Sync & Backup
sync.desc: External system integration and automated backups to keep operations data continuous.

deploy.title: Deployment Automation
deploy.desc: An operational pipeline that keeps build, upload, and restart steps consistent.

server.title: Production Runtime
server.desc: SSL, reverse proxy, and containerized runtime for stable internal-service quality.

how.title: What It Does
how.subtitle: These capabilities are not a feature list. Together they close the loop between input, planning, execution, and reporting in engineering operations.

worklog.title: Smart Worklog Tracking
worklog.description: Turns natural-language inputs into structured work records and makes repeated patterns or missing signals visible in daily operations.

resource.title: FTE Resource Planning
resource.description: Handles monthly allocation and scenario planning in the same matrix, including future hiring and vacancy assumptions.

project.title: Project & Milestone Management
project.description: Tracks project lifecycle and gate status inside the operating context so schedule and resource decisions do not drift apart.

financial.title: Financial Classification
financial.description: Automatically connects operational inputs to cost responsibility structures so reporting and finance tracking stay aligned.

reports.title: Plan vs Actual Reports
reports.description: Drills down plan-versus-actual gaps at department, project, and user level so execution issues become operational signals, not just report artifacts.

ai.title: AI-Powered Summaries
ai.description: Compresses weekly team activity into a readable operating summary so managers can understand flow faster and reduce repeated reporting work.

benefits.title: Measurable Results
benefits.subtitle: The point is not prettier screens. The real value is faster operational judgment, less repeated reporting work, and easier conversations between plans and execution.

reporting.label: Reporting Time
reporting.description: Monthly FTE reports generated in minutes instead of days of manual Excel manipulation.

visibility.label: Data Currency
visibility.description: From 2-3 week data lag to live dashboards with daily worklog updates.

tools.label: Tool Consolidation
tools.description: Single platform replaces SharePoint, Excel, email chains, and manual trackers.

accuracy.label: Classification Accuracy
accuracy.description: Rule-based engine auto-classifies timesheet entries. Low-confidence items flagged for review.

singleSource.title: Single Source of Truth
singleSource.description: Worklogs, allocations, projects, and gate status are connected in one operating context, so teams no longer jump across files to interpret reality.

selfService.title: Self-Service Reporting
selfService.description: Managers can inspect the data directly and make decisions immediately instead of waiting on data owners or manual file compilation.

compliance.title: Financial Compliance
compliance.description: Operational inputs stay close to financial classification logic, which improves recharge consistency and cost traceability.

scalable.title: Scalable Architecture
scalable.description: The platform was shaped as an operational base that can extend to more teams, business units, and future enterprise integrations.

worklogs.after: Web app with AI natural language input

resource.after: Interactive FTE matrix with scenario planning

next.title: What's Next
next.subtitle: The next step is not just adding screens. It is connecting this platform to a wider operating system for the organization.

phase1.label: Phase 1 — Active
phase1.title: Core Platform
phase1.description: Stabilizing worklogs, resource planning, project operations, classification, and summaries as one operational product.

phase2.label: Phase 2 — Planned
phase2.title: Advanced Analytics
phase2.description: Deeper trend analysis, predictive planning, and automated variance signals that turn operations data into a stronger decision tool.

phase3.label: Phase 3 — Planned
phase3.title: Multi-Team Expansion
phase3.description: Onboarding additional engineering teams so shared resources and common operating standards can run on the same platform.

phase4.label: Phase 4 — Future
phase4.title: Enterprise Integration Expansion
phase4.description: Connect Microsoft 365, SAP, and other operational systems so engineering operations data can flow into a wider decision-making environment.

considerations.title: Key Considerations
items: A data migration path that lets SharePoint and Excel based teams transition without disruption
An SSO and permission model that can accommodate subsidiary and business-unit level policies
IO and recharge mapping rules aligned with finance ownership
Continuous improvement of classification rules and AI summary quality based on accumulated operations data
